messages:
sara_support: FYI customer Helio Dynamics GmbH says their invoice is on hold — they expected reverse-charge but billing says VAT ID mismatch. They uploaded the EU VAT cert and Handelsregister extract.
vikram_billing: Can you paste the VAT ID and the account it's attached to? I can check our verification history. Also how big is the invoice? any POs involved?
sara_support: VAT: DE123456789, account: helio-prod (acct_0456). Invoice €48,000, PO 2034 attached. Customer insists VIES returned valid earlier.
oliver_engineer: pinging tax validation service logs for that id now. Seeing a validation result: "valid": true but owner_name normalised != billing_entity_name -> code vat_id_owner_mismatch.  
oliver_engineer: log snippet:
```
2026-03-16T09:42:11Z validate_vat_request id=DE123456789 resp={"status":"valid","name":"Helio Dynamics GmbH & Co KG","country":"DE","source":"vies"} decision=owner_mismatch billing_entity=Helio Dynamics GmbH
```
vikram_billing: interesting — VIES name has "& Co KG" whereas billing is plain "GmbH". That can trigger mismatch detection. Policy requires legal name match for auto-apply.
sara_support: customer says their legal name sometimes omits the suffix in billing systems. They provided Handelsregister excerpt showing registration as "Helio Dynamics GmbH & Co KG". I attached the PDF in the support ticket.
julien_sales: This is a big customer and the PO includes reverse-charge note. We need manual override asap. What's the workaround?
oliver_engineer: Two options: 1) manual billing override (billing team can set invoice as reverse-charge if docs reviewed) — quickest. 2) we relax name-normalisation heuristics for this account but that is a code change and needs QA.
vikram_billing: I can do manual override after legal confirms documents. I need: Handelsregister PDF + a matching VAT certificate that shows the ID. Also need confirmation that the PO is issued by the same legal entity (PO pdf or email). Send to billing@redwood.com and tag me.
sara_support: told customer to upload both files to the ticket and to include the PO email thread. They uploaded Handelsregister and a VAT cert scan but PO is from procurement@helio.com — forwarding now.
invoice-bot: Invoice  INV-2026-0345 moved to review queue by vikram_billing. Reason: VAT owner mismatch override requested.
oliver_engineer: Quick note for support: if you need a reproducible check call to our tax service use:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/internal/tax/validate -d '{"vat_id":"DE123456789"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
response includes decision_code and source. If decision_code=="owner_mismatch" we flag billing hold.
vikram_billing: I'll review docs now. ETA ~60m. If everything matches, I'll mark invoice as reverse-charge and release for payment. Otherwise we'll ask customer to provide additional legal proof (company extract showing DB entry linking VAT id).
sara_support: customer asked if we can accept a notarized letter instead — legal said yes but prefer original extracts. I'll relay.
julien_sales: Thanks team. Keep me in the loop. Customer concerned about payment timing.
vikram_billing: update: validated Handelsregister -> name matches VIES with suffix. Manual override done, invoice set to reverse-charge, billing released to AP. Customer notified. :white_check_mark:
sara_support: closing loop with customer now. thanks! :raised_hands:
